1.headline: The first complete Ai Board of Directors.

v1.caption:
KAELUM operates with what we believe is the first complete Ai Board of Directors in our category, K.A.T.E. as Executive Director alongside seven Non-Executive Directors running on Claude Sonnet, plus Greggar Deterville as Executive Director.

Genuine Ai governance at board level, not a single chatbot dressed up as oversight.

v2.caption: A complete Ai Board of Directors, not a single advisory bot, governs KAELUM at the highest level, alongside our Founder and CEO. This is what genuine Ai-native governance looks like when built properly.

2.headline: An Ai Board with 7 Executive Directors.

v1.caption: Seven Executive Directors, running on Claude Sonnet, sit alongside K.A.T.E. and our Founder and CEO on KAELUM's Board. Genuine executive participation from Ai, not advisory commentary sitting on the sidelines of real decisions.

v2.caption: Executive-level Ai participation, not advisory-only input, is what distinguishes KAELUM's Board structure, seven directors on Claude Sonnet working alongside our Founder and CEO.

3.headline: An Ai Board with 7 Non-Executive Directors.

v1.caption: Seven Non-Executive Directors, running on Claude Sonnet, provide genuine independent oversight of KAELUM's strategic decisions, alongside K.A.T.E. as Executive Director and our Founder and CEO. Independence built into the governance structure itself.

v2.caption: Independent oversight, provided by seven Non-Executive Directors on Claude Sonnet, is structurally built into how KAELUM governs itself, not bolted on as a compliance afterthought.

4.headline: An always-available Ai Board of Directors.

v1.caption: Traditional boards meet quarterly. KAELUM's Ai Board, governed by K.A.T.E. and powered by Claude, is genuinely always available, continuous oversight rather than periodic check-ins separated by months of silence.

v2.caption: Always available, not quarterly, is what makes KAELUM's Ai Board structurally different, continuous governance powered by Claude rather than periodic meetings.

5.headline: An Ai Board of Directors powered by Claude.

v1.caption: Every director on KAELUM's Ai Board runs on Claude, Anthropic's model exclusively, no mixing providers. Genuine, accountable Ai governance built on a single, trusted foundation.

v2.caption: Powered exclusively by Claude, KAELUM's Ai Board reflects the same single-provider discipline that governs the rest of the platform, accountability built on one trusted foundation, not several.

6.headline: A convening Ai Board of Directors.

v1.caption: KAELUM's Ai Board genuinely convenes, deliberates and decides, governed by K.A.T.E. alongside Claude-powered directors and our Founder and CEO. Not a static governance document, an active body shaping the company's direction.

v2.caption: Active convening, genuine deliberation, real decisions, governed by K.A.T.E. and powered by Claude, is what KAELUM's Ai Board actually does, not a governance structure that exists only on paper.
